quote: We introduce HarveyNER, the first dataset that annotates such coordinate‑oriented location mentions.
We evaluate performance using Precision / Recall / F1‑Score (percentages).
We fine‑tune the base‑uncased version of BERT with the BiLSTM‑CRF structure for experiments.
We trained three annotators and calculated their Inter‑Annotator Agreement (κ) scores based on the token‑level annotations.
